title: watch_heartbeat
description: U4b/R2 watcher liveness. ONE row per (tenantId, sourceType) — `_id` is the two-part key `<tenantId>:<sourceType>`, deliberately unlike watch_state's three-part `<tenantId>:<sourceType>:<sourceId>`: an individual item id has no meaning for the question 'did this whole polling phase run at all'. `lastHeartbeatAt` is refreshed by scripts/watch/run-watch.mjs at the END of each phase it completed (whether the phase succeeded or caught and logged an error — either way the process is alive and got back to that point). The staleness DETECTOR is apps/api/src/routes/health.ts, deliberately a different process: a detector that lives inside the writer dies with it, which is the exact failure R2 exists to catch. A missing row means 'that source type has never completed a run' and is treated as maximally stale, not as healthy (D-048).

lastHeartbeatAt.description: ISO-8601 instant at which a polling run for this source type last completed.
